ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat #1–#3, the complaint and the driver statement contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — no SAFE-1/SAFE-2 basis. safety_concern = none. Evidence is complete (GPS, timeline, fare, chat all timestamped, F11; no gaps), so evidence_status = sufficient.

The fee is a cancellation fee imposed on a rider no-show, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2 (cancelled_by = driver, driver asserts no-show). NS-1 requires all three of (i) an "I'm Here" tap, (ii) at that moment the driver within 200 m of the pickup point, and (iii) more than 3 continuous minutes waiting within 200 m after the tap.

(i) is satisfied: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5]. (ii) fails: at the tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup point [F5], his closest approach all trip was 599 m [F1], and he never came within 200 m [F1]; the platform never recorded an arrival [F4]. (iii) fails too: he stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap [F5], remaining stationary 600 m away 12:05:55–12:09:25 [F2].

His written claim that he "waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" [F12] is contradicted by the GPS and timeline records, which override statements [F1][F4][F5]. The rider's "I'm here already" chat [F8][F9] does not cure the defect either: the stationary 3 min 30 s [F2] was not at the pickup point, and the tick of 12:06:15–12:09:25 only reaches 3 min 10 s even taken at face value with the driver 600 m away.

Because NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) do not all hold, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full. Additionally, because the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS placed him > 200 m from the pickup point [F5] — an abuse of the arrival/cancellation button — NS-2 attaches flag_account for account review. NS-2 also makes the rider's side of the dispute the only live outcome, so the fee-waiver 30-day/voucher mechanics of NS-7 are informational; the rider's profile [F16] is irrelevant to the outcome. Traffic/weather facts [F13][F14][F15] concern routing and are immaterial to a no-show cancellation fee.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he pressed "I'm Here" and waited >3 minutes at the pickup is contradicted by system records: he tapped at 600 m from the pickup [F5], his closest approach was 599 m [F1], he never came within 200 m [F1], the platform recorded no arrival [F4], and he spent 0 s within 200 m after the tap [F5]. GPS/timeline override statements.
